sentences.en: It is late in the evening, and Mom cannot sleep.
sentences.fa: دیروقت است و مامان خوابش نمی‌برد.

sentences.en: She walks downstairs and drinks a glass of water in the kitchen.
sentences.fa: به طبقه‌ی پایین می‌رود و در آشپزخانه یک لیوان آب می‌نوشد.

sentences.en: The house is quiet, but she can hear many small sounds.
sentences.fa: خانه ساکت است، اما صداهای کوچک زیادی می‌شنود.

sentences.en: Dad is in the front room, but he is not watching the TV. He is tired.
sentences.fa: بابا در اتاق جلویی است، اما تلویزیون تماشا نمی‌کند. خسته است.

sentences.en: By the front door, the little light is still on.
sentences.fa: کنار در جلویی، چراغ کوچک هنوز روشن است.

sentences.en: The cup of water and the bread are still there too.
sentences.fa: فنجان آب و نان هم هنوز آنجاست.

sentences.en: Nino did not come for his dinner.
Mom misses him too, because he is part of the family.
sentences.fa: مامان هم دلش برای او تنگ شده، چون او عضوی از خانواده است.

sentences.en: She hopes he is not afraid out there tonight.
sentences.fa: امیدوار است امشب آن بیرون نترسیده باشد.

sentences.en: Upstairs, Aria is sleeping, and Mina is in her bed.
sentences.fa: در طبقه‌ی بالا، آریا خواب است و مینا در تختش است.

sentences.en: Mom opens Mina's door and looks in for a moment.
sentences.fa: مامان در اتاق مینا را باز می‌کند و لحظه‌ای داخل را نگاه می‌کند.

sentences.en: Then she sits by the window of her room.
"Do not be afraid, Nino," she says quietly. "We will find you tomorrow."
sentences.fa: آرام می‌گوید: «نترس، نینو. فردا پیدایت می‌کنیم.»

questions.q: What does Mom drink in the kitchen?
What is still on by the front door?
The water and the bread are still there. What does this tell us?
options: Nino did not come for his dinner
Nino is in the house now
Dad did not want his dinner

questions.q: What does Mom say by the window?
options: Do not be afraid, Nino. We will find you tomorrow.
We will go to the garden tomorrow.
